venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Wednesday 3/18.** Event-only night (event sales $10,690, 91 event guests, $1,402 event void); Garden, D&C and Kitchen notes just say see event notes (none posted). Went well: Sasha staging and the event all around. To improve: passing food and keeping guests out of the doorway. Favorite moment: easiest event ever. Report submitted 9:16pm the same evening. MOD: Cory / Kevin.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Wednesday 3/18.** Smooth flow; not much after 11pm, sent Bowen home; slow evening to close. Guest count and check average are not on the Toast Z-report (will average from the three close-out reports going forward). Comps $40. Top sellers: Year of the Trees, Masari/Cielo Asilo, Material Control/Root & Rye (ties). Door: despite cold and post-St. Paddy's, a good crowd of D&C fans visiting the city; fully seated 7-10pm; slower open with table requests, then packed with duos and trios; constantly moving the books; brief waitlist (max 45 min) done by 9:30; streets slow by 10pm; one guest found D&C via Gemini; welcomed Cole (AGM, Taq Tribeca) and a bartender from Hudson. No no-shows. Kitchen: none.
